The whole suite on 45a17b3's source on this Windows 11 workstation (offscreen Qt, the shared venv, a CHATMON_INSTANCE of its own), which runs every test these criteria's earlier receipts named: 1259 passed, 179 skipped (other platforms' tests, each skip with its reason), exit 0; per-test results are mapped from the log by docs/delivery/reports/wave4/cilog.py. sde_check.py made two copies of 45a17b3's wheel inputs with file times a fortnight apart, and built each with python -m build --no-isolation --wheel on the hash-locked build tools. The wheels differed without SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and were byte-identical with it set to the commit's time, which is how packages.yml's 'Date the build by its commit' step sets it (observed in Packages run 43743804716). The commit time is the worktree's HEAD's, a commit after 45a17b3 that changes docs/ only (git diff 45a17b3 HEAD outside docs/ is empty), so the wheel's inputs are 45a17b3's.
